title: Retire a product feature or API
summary: When a company plans to end a product, interface version or customer-facing capability. An authorized retirement with migrated or explicitly resolved customers, controlled shutdown and retained completion evidence.
outcomes: An authorized retirement with migrated or explicitly resolved customers, controlled shutdown and retained completion evidence.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a company plans to end a product, interface version or customer-facing capability.

parts.title: Inventory usage and customer commitments
parts.guidance: Identify affected customers, integrations, contracts, data and internal dependencies. Record observed usage and owners; lack of recent traffic alone does not establish that retirement is contractually permitted.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve the retirement and customer remedy plan
parts.guidance: Product, legal and support owners review obligations, proposed timing, alternatives and refund or migration options. Resolve commitments and material customer risks before approving an announcement.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Approve the retirement and customer remedy plan

parts.title: Prepare migration and recovery materials
parts.guidance: Draft migration instructions, compatibility tests, customer notices and an exception register. Define what evidence must exist before access or stored data can be removed.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Issue approved notices and offer migration support
parts.guidance: Authorized operators send the reviewed communications through approved channels. Retain delivery records and assign owners to customer objections or unsupported migrations.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Issue approved notices and offer migration support

parts.title: Verify migration and authorize shutdown
parts.guidance: Responsible owners review remaining users, contractual exceptions and recovery options. Stop the affected shutdown when conditions are unmet; obtain explicit approval for production or data changes.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Confirm shutdown and close residual obligations
parts.guidance: Authorized operators perform the approved shutdown and verify monitoring, billing and data handling outcomes. Keep unresolved support or retention duties assigned and publish only verified completion status.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Confirm shutdown and close residual obligations

verify.how: An authorized retirement with migrated or explicitly resolved customers, controlled shutdown and retained completion evidence.

notes.text: Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is UK public-sector practice; adapted operational coordination. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
